text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having seized victory in the Takarazuka 
Kinen, Mejiro Ryan lets out a shout of 
joy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen congratulated her, 
entrusting Mejiro Ryan to excel in 
middle-distance races as a proud Umamusume 
of the Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"...And separately from that, they wished 
for Mejiro Ryan to grow into a fine lady."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Told to become a wonderful lady by their 
next showdown—the year-end Arima Kinen— 
Mejiro Ryan fell into a panic.
